verdict.rationale: 1Password documents its own machine-credential mechanisms. Service Accounts automate secrets access for applications, and the Credential Broker gives machine workflows short-lived access to secrets, which is a time-bounded form of least privilege. The pack never documents how these credentials are scoped (for example per-vault or read-only permissions) or that they are aimed at AI agents. missing for 10: documented per-vault/per-permission scoping of service account or Connect tokens, explicit agent-targeted credential issuance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Use the 1Password Credential Broker to give CI/CD and other machine workflows short-lived access to secrets, without managing service account tokens.
1Password Service Accounts help automate secrets management in your applications and infrastructure without the need to deploy additional services.
